==About me==

''Hey everyone! I have loved the Wheel of Time series since I first picked them up... which was only a year ago! I am currently on my second read-through of the books in preparation for my first reading of the Towers of Midnight. I'm so excited that the series is finally coming to a conclusion, but am also dissappointed that it will eventually all be over... If you ever want to talk or ask my opinion on something feel free!!''
